text:
Ravi (Marketing): quick sync 00: dashboard is showing conflicting numbers for the launch post vs webinar cohorts. want to agree on the benchmark narrative before Monday exec slides.
Sofia (Growth): noticed the landing conversion is up but MQL rate isn't. could be lead routing losing UTM at our /rt redirect. seeing divergence after day 2.
Nina (Analytics): dug in  here's the short read: 1) dashboard uses session-based attribution by default (7-day). 2) marketing wants 30-day event-based for launch narratives. 3) redirect strips utm_term on some flows. link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/launch-kpi-v2 (live).
Tom (Sales Ops): live data from SFDC shows 21% higher close-ready leads when we include late signups (8-30d). sales prefers 30-day for pipeline impact.
Ava (Content): for the blog post headline we need a clean single stat. if we pick 30-day, callout that it's '30-day post-launch signups' and include raw n.
Nina (Analytics): sample sizes: total visits = 24,178; tracked signups (30d) = 412; tracked signups (7d) = 275. I'll add both to the dashboard table.
Sofia (Growth): thanks. question: do we include paid reattributions in the headline? Paid channels redistributed after Day 3 and inflate 30-day. maybe mark paid separately.
Ravi (Marketing): let's do this: headline = 30-day organic + webinar cohort. paid gets a separate callout. keep 7-day in appendix.
Tom (Sales Ops): routing fix proposal: append original utm_* as _orig_utm_* on redirect. that preserves source for backend attribution. I'll spin a ticket.
Nina (Analytics): quick SQL I used to validate utm loss:
```
SELECT user_id, first_touch_url, COALESCE(utm_source,'unknown') AS utm_source
FROM attribution_events
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
AND first_touch_url LIKE '%/rt%'
LIMIT 50
```
Shows many rows with utm_source = NULL after redirect.
Ava (Content): timeline for post copy? need the final stat by Monday 10am to craft the narrative.
Ravi (Marketing): action items: (1) Nina add 7d/30d columns + source split on dashboard (due Mon 9am). (2) Tom file redirect ticket + tag @eng-oncall (due Mon EOD). (3) Ava draft blog + 2 headline options (due Mon 10am). (4) Sofia run 48hr landing copy A/B (small traffic).
Sofia (Growth): A/B test config: variant A = baseline, B = webinar CTA. will send experiment id in thread when live. keep sample ~2k visitors.
kpi-bot: Weekly KPI post scheduled: every Mon 08:30 PST - includes signups (7d/30d), MQLs, top 5 utm_sources, experiment flags. First post: 2026-08-03.
Nina (Analytics): will also add a one-paragraph caveat for the exec deck about attribution window & paid redistribution.
Ravi (Marketing): great. let's reconvene Tuesday after A/B results. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
